scene_analysis.scene_overview: A subway station with a train on the right side and a woman sitting on a bench on the left side. The walls are made of brown stone and there are advertisements on them. There are two people walking in the distance. The ceiling is made of concrete and has fluorescent lights. The floor is made of gray tiles with a yellow line running down the middle.
scene_analysis.buildings: The building on the left is made of brown stone and has a large advertisement on it. It is taller than the other building. The building on the right is white with orange doors and windows.
scene_analysis.materials: The building on the left has a red box attached to it. The building on the right has a black window.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There is a bench on the left side of the platform. A person is sitting on it.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are no plants or trees in the area.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs on the wall, including a red sign with a white T on it.
